chunks: Among the approved ones is Humran bin Ayyin:

key_terms.الْمَحْمُودِينَ: The approved or praised ones, referring to reliable narrators
key_terms.حُمْرَانُ بْنُ أَعْيَنَ: Humran ibn A'yun, a prominent companion of the Imams

ai.seo_question: Who is Humran ibn A'yun in Shia hadith literature?
ai.summary: Humran ibn A'yun is highlighted here as one of the 'approved' (al-mahmudin) among the Four Emissaries (al-Nuwwab al-Arba'ah), a distinction that underscores his high status and reliability in transmitting the Imam's directives during the Minor Occultation. His inclusion in this introductory segment serves to validate the authenticity of the subsequent hadith by anchoring it within the trusted network of direct deputies to the Twelfth Imam.
